title: Podium team binding
description: Binds podium role slots to project agents. Place at <repo>/.claude/team.json.

planner.description: Agent that brainstorms, writes spec and skeleton plan. Default podium:composer.

critic.description: Agent that reviews plans and final diffs in a fresh context. Default podium:critic.

builder.description: Agent that implements one plan task at a time. Default podium:performer.

scout.description: Agent for single-step lookups and light edits. Default podium:scout.

workspace.description: Workspace root. null = $HOME/.agent-work. Relative paths resolve from the repo root.

fallbackModel.description: Model ID used only when a pinned model is unavailable; the conductor reports the switch.
